canon_ref.note: A reality-warping horror she also recalls near his cave is not a named canon monster the game has data for yet; left out rather than guessed.

b2.ryoka_remembers_teriarch_is_dragon.summary: Ryoka's restored memory: on her first visit, wounded and dying, she saw Teriarch's true dragon form before he wiped it and adopted a human disguise.

stage.line: A crowd fills the yard below the inn's door, drawn by a song none of them have ever heard.
stage.note: M8.2: a friendly gathering, not a fight. Erin is already home on her own schedule. Ryoka has no npc_behaviour entry yet, so she is not walkable, but keeps the runner role for the story.

b2.erin_iphone_concert_night.summary: To out-do the copycat vendors, Erin sings pop songs off Ryoka's phone from the inn's roof, amplified by Pisces. A huge crowd comes from Liscor for an all-night concert; she reaches Level 21 and unlocks the [Singer] class.

b2.mystery_chess_opponent_first_move.summary: Overnight, the enchanted board's unseen opponent makes a move, confirming the magic link is live.

system.name: [Innkeeper]
system.note: Text says she reaches Level 21 here; not stated whether Innkeeper specifically.
